author: Bobby Grayson
message:
Add /directory, an inventory of everything running on the box

A page that lists every domain, container, route, and museum project on
the server, styled in the same System 7 Finder language as the home page:
pinstriped desktop, white windows with 1px black borders, invert-on-hover
rows. Six stacked windows, each with a status bar reporting real counts.

Infrastructure facts (containers, domains, routes) are module attributes.
The museum list reads from museum_projects so the page cannot drift from
/admin/museum -- adding a project there shows up here, pixel icon included.

Two numbers were wrong in docs/PROJECTS.md and are corrected here: the
Caddyfile has 12 host blocks, not 13 (bobbby.online/arena/ is a path, so
it is listed but not counted), and the router has 93 unique paths (69
pages, 24 API) rather than the ~72 estimate.

Ships an og-directory card at 1200x630, hand-authored as SVG in the same
style and exported to PNG, following the og-2048/og-nyc-census pattern.
OG tags go through the page_title/page_description/page_image assigns
rather than meta_tags, since a non-empty meta_tags replaces the root
layout's default block entirely -- which is how trees_live lost its
og:image.

author: Bobby Grayson

feat(phish_lab): /phish_lab — win95 anomaly laboratory for Phish data

Chart builder over three datasets (1,024 shows, 992 songs, 20,669
performances) merged from relisten show records, phish.net likes/jamcharts,
and the phishjustjams 15-style jam scorecard. Canvas+D3 scatter/histogram
with pickable X/Y/color/size axes, CVD-validated era palette, outlier
leaderboards (per-song duration z-scores, setlist rarity, era-relative
jamminess, bustout shelf gaps, style-defining songs) that jump-and-highlight
the chart, and a click-to-inspect properties window with scorecard bars.

Data precomputed by scripts/build_phish_lab_data.py.

author: Bobby Grayson
message:
feat(blinks): /blinks-reader, a contact-sheet view with a real lightbox

The front page is a newspaper: two hand-set columns sized so the whole
thing fits one screenful, which leaves pictures at 48px -- a table of
contents, not an image.

This is the other way to read the same links. An auto-fill grid takes as
many columns as the window holds (4 across at 1440 vs 2), 60 links a
page instead of 30, and each card carries what the front page has no
room for: description, quoted post, tags, date. Thumbnails open into a
full-viewport lightbox at full resolution, numbered across the whole
page so arrowing off the last picture of one link lands on the first of
the next, wrapping at both ends.

Filters and URL params are shared, so a ?q= or ?tags= link works in
either view and the masthead tabs swap between them.

Bluesky video only ever stored a thumbnail, so video opens as a large
still that links out rather than a player pretending to have a file.

author: Robert Grayson
message:
fix: vendor Leaflet 1.9.4 — unpkg CSS never matched its SRI hash

The leaflet.css integrity hash carried in this repo never matched the
bytes unpkg (or jsdelivr, or the npm tarball) actually serve, so the
browser silently discarded the stylesheet and tiles rendered scattered
down the page. Verified: npm registry tarball, jsdelivr, and unpkg all
agree on sha256-...miZyoHS5obTRR9BMY=; the hash in the repo was
sha256-...KFQW0q+MJTEXx+bCw=.

Vendor the canonical dist files (from the npm registry tarball) into
assets/vendor/leaflet: the CSS is @imported into app.css and the JS is
bundled by esbuild via a relative import (unaffected by
--external:leaflet). window.L is set for nyc_map.js and the
leaflet-draw/heat plugins, whose runtime CDN loader now short-circuits.
No CDN, no SRI, no load race.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

author: Robert Grayson
message:
fix: MTA bus map never loaded via live navigation; hook now owns Leaflet loading

Inline <script> tags in a LiveView render are inert when the page is
reached via push_navigate (e.g. Finder -> MTA Map), so window.L was
never defined and L.map() failed silently. The hook now loads Leaflet
JS+CSS itself behind a promise (same CDN + SRI), buffers bus updates
until ready, and shows an error message on load failure. Also replaces
the blocking geolocation alert() with an auto-dismissing hint and adds
100dvh overrides so iOS Safari doesn't clip the map under the toolbar.
